name: commit-forest
description: A pixel forest for your GitHub profile: one tree for every day you contributed.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.js --bundle --platform=node --target=node24 --format=esm --outfile=dist/index.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cfRequire } from 'module'; const require = __cfRequire(import.meta.url);" && npm run site
scripts.site: mkdir -p docs && esbuild site/app.js --bundle --format=esm --outfile=docs/app.js && cp site/index.html docs/index.html && cp engine/forest-engine.txt docs/engine.js && touch docs/.nojekyll
